findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "escalate_to_human" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_booking_link" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Free, instant pre-flight check for a booking URL. Classifies which booking platform a URL belongs to and tells you whether import_booking_url will accept it, WI…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agent-broker" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_message, capture_lead, send_transactional_confirmation, handle_inbound, escalate_to_human, check_booking_link, import_booking_url, call_business, check_compliance, screen_sanctions, map_trade_restriction, get_conversation · Private data: handle_inbound, escalate_to_human, verify_company_record · Public sink: send_message, capture_lead, send_transactional_confirmation, handle_inbound, get_status, preview_cost, self_test, check_compliance · Destructive: self_test, check_booking_link, check_compliance, screen_sanctions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_message, capture_lead, send_transactional_confirmation, handle_inbound, escalate_to_human, check_booking_link, import_booking_url, call_business, check_compliance, screen_sanctions, map_trade_restriction, get_conversation · Private data: handle_inbound, escalate_to_human, verify_company_record · Public sink: send_message, capture_lead, send_transactional_confirmation, handle_inbound, get_status, preview_cost, self_test, check_compliance · Destructive: self_test, check_booking_link, check_compliance, screen_sanctions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
